known_constraints: Dashboard target p95 < 500ms locked at DS-016 — any future caching layer must respect cache-invalidation when ledger rows arrive (especially back-dated rows that trigger _recompute_forward).
Sales Report filters all .in_() parameter-bound — TC-158 verifies SQL-injection safety; any new filter must follow the shared _build_filters helper pattern (DS-017).
TD-008 first-row insert race still V2-deferred — any new write path on the ledger MUST go through domain.stock._apply with pg_advisory_xact_lock-first (DS-015).
Read endpoints return AssertionError → 500 on invariant breach (DS-016 ledger-corruption signal). Any observability layer must surface those 500s loudly rather than swallow them.
suggested_prd_updates: AC-045 dashboard latency was numeric in S3 spec (p95 < 500ms over 10 runs at 6 pairs × 12 months). Confirm this stays the contract in V2 or relax if production hardware differs.

PRD currently has no AC for pagination on /reports/sales or /sales — set a row-count threshold (e.g. 'response > 10,000 rows triggers warning' or 'reports paginated at 500/page') before V2 if reports grow large.
Consider documenting the F-012 carry-forward correctness as a first-class AC (not just verification) so it lands in test_spec for future sprints that touch domain.stock.
Frontend Dashboard + Sales Report ACs live in PRD scope but no UI ACs exist for chart-vs-table layouts — clarify at /ases-ui-design S3.
